row.notes: Reads an 8-byte length through stream vtable +0x30, compares it with the stream size (vtable +0xa8), copies the 0x6c-byte header to dataset+0x260..+0x2cb (byte +0x280 clamped to 0/1), then walks the records: record size = 4 plus the sizes of the channels in +0x220..+0x228 whose mask matches the record header bits >> 18, each record appended to buffer +0x1e0 (capacity +0x1e8, cursor +0x1f0, high mark +0x1f8) with its offset in index table +0x208 (count +0x214). When +0x130 is set it validates lap time +0x268, sectors +0x26c/+0x270/+0x274 and more than 100 samples (else error 0x50). Returns 0 on success, 0x55 on failure; logs 'Successfully read %d bytes, sent to DataSet %s' with name +0x1b8. Callers: Game_GhostLap_ApplyDatasetTelemetry, Game_GhostLapHandler_Update (personal best) and OnSessionRivalSearchCompleted (rival ghost) load ghost telemetry with it; 0x142917150 loads up to four datasets from 0xc800-byte memory buffers. Hook point to inject or dump ghost telemetry. (lab L1 re-check with caller context 2026-11-27)
